newsitem.title: USA: Home Lending to make acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Home Lending to make acquisition.

text.p: Home Lending Associates Inc said Tuesday it has signed a letter to acquire rights to manufacture and market products currently held under a license agreement by Emerald Diagnostics Inc.
It said it plans to issue some 3.0 million shares of common stock, which would represent about three quarters of stock outstanding after the deal.
Of the stock to be issued, 2.1 million shares would be held by Emerald and 900,000 shares held by Donald Dorn, the inventor of the patented technologies.
In connection with the acquisition, the issued and outstanding common stock would be reverse-split one-for-three to some 980,000 shares.
The principal products being acquired include U.S. Food and Drug Administration cleared processes to stabilize urine samples during transportation.
The company said it plans to change its name to reflect its new direction.
